<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
const raw=document.getElementById("fixture").textContent.trim();
const bin=window.atob(raw);
const bytes=new Uint8Array(bin.length);
for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)bytes[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
const data=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));

const courseGrid=document.getElementById("courseGrid");
const meta=document.getElementById("meta");
const slider=document.getElementById("time");
const timeText=document.getElementById("timeText");
const phaseText=document.getElementById("phaseText");
const hfTick=document.getElementById("hfTick");
const miniTick=document.getElementById("miniTick");
const top=document.getElementById("top");
const side=document.getElementById("side");
const mini=document.getElementById("mini");
const tc=top.getContext("2d");
const sc=side.getContext("2d");
const mc=mini.getContext("2d");
mc.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;

let courseIndex=4;
let currentUs=0;
let playing=false;
let lastTime=0;

const phaseName=["PRE","CONTACT","FOLLOW"];

function currentCourse(){return data.courses[courseIndex];}
function sampleAt(frames,t){
  let chosen=frames[0];
  for(const frame of frames){
    if(frame[0]>t)break;
    chosen=frame;
  }
  return chosen;
}
function nearestStored(frames,t){
  let best=frames[0],dist=Math.abs(frames[0][0]-t);
  for(const frame of frames){
    const d=Math.abs(frame[0]-t);
    if(d<dist){best=frame;dist=d;}
  }
  return best;
}
function world(frame){
  return {
    grip:{x:frame[2],y:frame[3],z:frame[4]},
    tip:{x:frame[5],y:frame[6],z:frame[7]},
    sweet:{x:frame[8],y:frame[9],z:frame[10]}
  };
}
function pov(frame){
  return {
    grip:frame[11]===null?null:{x:frame[11],y:frame[12]},
    tip:frame[13]===null?null:{x:frame[13],y:frame[14]},
    sweet:frame[15]===null?null:{x:frame[15],y:frame[16]}
  };
}
function map(v,a,b,p0,p1){return p0+(v-a)/(b-a)*(p1-p0);}
function clear(ctx,w,h){
  ctx.fillStyle="#070a0f";ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
  ctx.strokeStyle="#151c25";ctx.lineWidth=1;
  for(let x=0;x<w;x+=40){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,0);ctx.lineTo(x,h);ctx.stroke();}
  for(let y=0;y<h;y+=40){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,y);ctx.lineTo(w,y);ctx.stroke();}
}
function drawTop(course,frame){
  const w=top.width,h=top.height;clear(tc,w,h);
  const mx=x=>map(x,-1.45,.55,36,w-24);
  const mz=z=>map(z,-.95,1.25,h-22,20);
  tc.strokeStyle="#283342";tc.lineWidth=1;tc.beginPath();tc.moveTo(mx(0),0);tc.lineTo(mx(0),h);tc.stroke();
  tc.strokeStyle="#76d5ff";tc.globalAlpha=.52;tc.lineWidth=2;tc.beginPath();
  let first=true;
  for(const f of course.highFidelity){const p=world(f).sweet;if(first){tc.moveTo(mx(p.x),mz(p.z));first=false}else tc.lineTo(mx(p.x),mz(p.z));}
  tc.stroke();tc.globalAlpha=1;
  const p=world(frame);
  tc.strokeStyle="#f4f1e8";tc.lineWidth=4;tc.beginPath();tc.moveTo(mx(p.grip.x),mz(p.grip.z));tc.lineTo(mx(p.tip.x),mz(p.tip.z));tc.stroke();
  tc.fillStyle=frame[1]===1?"#f5c542":"#76d5ff";tc.beginPath();tc.arc(mx(p.sweet.x),mz(p.sweet.z),5,0,Math.PI*2);tc.fill();
  tc.fillStyle="#738196";tc.font="11px monospace";tc.fillText("BATTER ←  x  → PLATE",12,16);
}

  const w=side.width,h=side.height;clear(sc,w,h);
  const mz=z=>map(z,-.95,1.25,28,w-24);
  const my=y=>map(y,.2,2.25,h-20,18);
  sc.strokeStyle="#283342";sc.lineWidth=1;sc.beginPath();sc.moveTo(mz(0),0);sc.lineTo(mz(0),h);sc.stroke();
